**Claim.** Each account has a primary workgroup. If you create no workgroups, all queries run in it by default. It cannot be deleted, and the default permissions allow all authenticated users access.

**Write it as.** `Each account has a primary workgroup` · `The primary workgroup cannot be deleted`

**Scope.** per account; default; not adjustable; no other workgroups created.

> "Each account has a primary workgroup. By default, if you have not created any workgroups, all queries in your account run in the primary workgroup. The primary workgroup cannot be deleted. The default permissions allow all authenticated users access to this workgroup."

### athena-workgroups-two-cost-controls-one-per-query-many-per-workgroup

**Claim.** Athena has two types of cost controls, a per-query limit and a per-workgroup limit. Each workgroup can have only one per-query limit and multiple per-workgroup limits.

**Scope.** per workgroup; maximum; not adjustable.
